title: VIBRA: Backward-Compatible Cross-Modal Retrieval with Consensus Barycenters
abstract: arXiv:2611.23606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Backward-compatible retrieval enables a new encoder to query the gallery that an old model has already encoded, so that a cross-modal retrieval system can be upgraded without re-encoding billions of items. Existing compatible methods either fit the old query and stay near the accuracy of the old model, or run the old and the new encoder for every query. We propose VIBRA, which matches relevance on the old gallery, corrects the errors of a single model with the barycenter of several views, which is itself a query in the old space, and trains the new encoder to inherit this consensus, so that models absent at deployment still shape every query. We show that the barycenter gains margin over the average of its views exactly when their hardest irrelevant items differ, and we characterize the share of this gain that one encoder can reach. On five benchmarks with five upgrades among six CLIP, MetaCLIP and SigLIP2 backbones, VIBRA is the best

translated_title: VIBRA：基于共识重心的向后兼容跨模态检索
translated_abstract: 向后兼容检索使新编码器能够查询旧模型已编码的图库，从而无需对数十亿条目重新编码即可升级跨模态检索系统。现有的兼容方法要么拟合旧的查询而停留在旧模型的精度附近，要么对每个查询同时运行旧编码器和新编码器。我们提出VIBRA，它在旧图库上匹配相关性，用多个视图的重心来纠正单个模型的错误——该重心本身也是旧空间中的一个查询——并训练新编码器继承这一共识，使得部署时并不存在的模型仍然塑造着每个查询。我们证明了当各视图最困难的不相关条目互不相同时，重心恰好能比其视图的平均值获得优势，并刻画了单个编码器所能达到的这一增益的份额。在六个CLIP、MetaCLIP和SigLIP2骨干网络之间的五次升级所涉及的五个基准测试上，VIBRA表现最佳。
tldr: VIBRA利用多个视图的共识重心来纠正单个模型的错误，并训练新编码器继承这一共识，实现了无需重新编码数十亿条目即可升级跨模态检索系统的向后兼容方案，在五个基准测试上取得最佳性能。
en_tdlr: VIBRA corrects single-model errors using the consensus barycenter of multiple views and trains the new encoder to inherit this consensus, enabling backward-compatible cross-modal retrieval upgrades without re-encoding billions of items, achieving the best performance on five benchmarks.
